Big & Spacious for family gathering
Feb 2025 • Family
This seafood restaurant is definitely the most spacious, making it perfect for groups, families, or anyone who wants to enjoy great food without feeling crowded. The seafood here is impressively fresh, nothing frozen, which really shows in the taste and texture. Their Cajun sauce is bold and spicy, so if you love heat, that’s the one to go for. If you prefer something lighter, the orange sauce is surprisingly refreshing and pairs well with shrimp or mussels. One of the best dishes is actually the noodle, simple but full of flavor. The crab cheese oven dish served with bread is also a must-try; it’s creamy and comforting. The crabs here are huge, and you can even pick your own live king crab or lobster. While the prices aren’t cheap, the quality and American style seafood experience make it worth it. Highly recommended for seafood lovers.
